tools.name: list_agencies
tools.description: Your own agency and every organization you are in, with your role in each and whether it answers right now. Pass one as `agency` to any other tool.

tools.name: list_requests
tools.description: Requests agents filed for things they can't do themselves: what they need, why, where each stands, and the conversation with the Agency Engineer.

tools.name: answer_request
tools.description: Close a request: done (say what was done, so the agent knows) or rejected (anything drafted for it is discarded). The agent hears on its next run.

tools.name: reply_to_request
tools.description: Write in an open request, to the Agency Engineer (as in the app: everyone on the request sees it, and the Engineer is woken to answer).

tools.description: Give an agent a job, from you: it starts on it as soon as it can and marks it done with the result (agent_activity shows it). For a question or a quic

tools.name: read_agent

tools.name: agent_activity
tools.description: What one agent did since a time (default: the start of today): its DM channel posts (each run's write-up and the tools it used), the people's messages

tools.name: latest_report
tools.description: An agent's latest report: the write-up of its last run that made one, and where its reports go (the place its person chose, e.g. a Drive folder).

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: Every integration (the services agents' tools run on): connected or not, draft or live, its tools. Plus whether code plugins are allowed.

tools.name: read_integration
tools.description: An integration's definition (YAML), and a plugin's code. The shipped ones - brave-search (HTTP), github and gmail (code) - show the format.

tools.name: test_integration
tools.description: Call one of an integration's tools for real (a draft or a live one), and see what an agent would. A plugin's code can't be tried before it's published

tools.name: publish_integration
tools.description: Make a draft live, and optionally give its tools to an agent. A plugin first gets the independent security review; a serious finding stops it. Done he

tools.description: Try an integration's event (draft or live) without waking anyone: a real poll showing what it finds, and the webhook address to paste into the service

tools.description: Subscribe an agent to live events: it wakes when they happen, as well as on its schedule. list_integrations shows each integration's events.

tools.description: Give an agent tools that a live integration (or the agency's built-ins) provides, each at a tier.

tools.name: discard_integration
tools.description: Throw away a draft (a redraft of a live one goes back to the live version), or remove an added integration entirely. Shipped ones can't be removed.
